# The corpus is test/yaml-test-schema/schema-core.json. Every other case
# in it MUST read exactly as the core schema says, and every input listed
# here MUST still read differently. All three runners
# rs/tests/yaml_test_schema_test.rs) read this file, so the runtimes cannot
# When the parser comes to read one of these as the core schema does,
# DELETE its line: the test will tell you to. Never add a line to silence a
# regression in a case that used to pass.
# (lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored)
# Documented leniency: YAML 1.1 booleans. The plugin reads yes/no/on/off (in
# these three casings) as booleans, as its README says; the core schema
# Inherited leniency: jsonic's number syntax. Digit separators (_), binary
# (0b), and a sign before a radix prefix are numbers to jsonic; the core
# schema has none of them, so it reads these as strings.
